episodes.synopsis: When Tanguy the truck bumps into a mooring post at the dock and drives away unaware that his brakes are out, the rescue team tries to intercept him.
episodes.title: Rescue Team of Broom’s Town

episodes.synopsis: SchoolB wants to give balloons to the kids he takes to school. But when the balloons fly away, it's up to the Rescue Team to get them back.
episodes.title: SchoolB’s Present

episodes.synopsis: Despite Mr. Builder's warnings about the wet concrete, Bruner takes a spill and falls right in. Now, the Rescue Team must find a way to help.
episodes.title: Concrete Fuss

episodes.synopsis: Cleany takes in a lost cat and the two become fast friends. But when the cat's owner comes calling, Cleany has trouble saying goodbye.
episodes.title: New Friends

episodes.synopsis: The team learns the importance of regular checkups when Spooky accidentally starts a fire after skipping his appointment with the nurse.
episodes.title: Regular Checkup Day

episodes.synopsis: When Cap spreads a rumor about a spooky ghost living in the forest, three kid cars set out to discover if ghosts are real or just pretend.
episodes.title: Fuss About Ghost

episodes.synopsis: When the town's streets are blocked for repairs, SchoolB rushes to find an alternate route and learns that being in a hurry can lead to accidents.
episodes.title: Try Not to Hurry

episodes.synopsis: Jealous when Poke is praised for digging up a valuable old tire, Bruner sets out to make a find of his own but soon runs into trouble.
episodes.title: I Want to Be Praised

episodes.synopsis: During a rainstorm, some tires go missing from Wheeler's store. Is there a thief in town, or does the mystery have another explanation?
episodes.title: Trust Your Friends

episodes.synopsis: Helly is disappointed when nobody remembers his birthday. Later, Poli and the gang search for a way to make it up to their friend.
episodes.title: Helly's Birthday

episodes.synopsis: When an out-of-order charging station sends Cleany into overdrive, it's up to the Rescue Team to calm him down before someone gets hurt.
episodes.title: Where Are You Going, Cleany?

episodes.synopsis: Mickey can't understand why his friends don't care about guarding the wet concrete. He vows to do it himself but ends up in a sticky situation.
episodes.title: Mickey Is Angry!

episodes.synopsis: When Grandpa Musty gives Mini an old-fashioned spare tire, she worries her friends will make fun of her because the tire isn't exactly cool.
episodes.title: I Love You, Grandpa!

episodes.synopsis: When Posty spots Spooky making a mistake, he shares the story with his friends. But Posty soon learns that mistakes happen -- even to him.
episodes.title: It's Okay to Make a Mistake

episodes.synopsis: The gang's getting excited about the town's talent show. When Dump rushes his work so he won't miss the contest, he ends up needing some help.
episodes.title: Talent Contest

episodes.synopsis: When Annie loses track of her doll, SchoolB promises to help. But finding the doll may be too big a job for SchoolB without some assistance.
episodes.title: Keep Your Promise

episodes.synopsis: When too many of his friends ask for his help at once, Cleany tries to make everyone happy. Instead, he winds up in a dangerous situation.
episodes.title: Please, Cleany!

episodes.synopsis: Spooky wants to break the record for the longest time between baths. But when he's mistaken for a filthy monster, he realizes it's good to be clean.
episodes.title: Let’s Be Clean!

episodes.synopsis: When Cap and Posty get stuck between two trees, they must put their bickering aside and remember why they're best friends in the first place.
episodes.title: The Friendship Tree

episodes.synopsis: Max's bad memory has everyone worried. When a fire breaks out, it's up to Max to pass along the location to the Rescue Team -- if he can remember it.
episodes.title: Remember, Max!

episodes.synopsis: When Mary falls asleep in a pipe that's about to be used in construction, Cleany calls on the Rescue Team to help his friend before it's too late.
episodes.title: Hide and Seek

episodes.synopsis: Beny wants to be a part of the Rescue Team, like his hero, Roy. But when Beny gets a chance to show his stuff, he finds himself in over his head.
episodes.title: Beny’s Dream

episodes.synopsis: When the town's energy runs out, it's up to the Rescue Team to get the lights back on and teach people the importance of conserving.
episodes.title: Escape from the Energy Crisis

episodes.synopsis: While playing ball, Posty and Cap get into a feud. Later, the two friends create an awkward situation when they force Cleany to pick a side.
episodes.title: Whose Side Should I Be On?

episodes.synopsis: While patrolling the woodlands, Helly hurts his propeller and must rest while the rest of the Rescue Team sets out to save Terry the truck.
episodes.title: Be Healthy

episodes.synopsis: Whooper the bus comes to town, and everyone warns him about a big storm. But when Whooper doesn't listen, the Rescue Team must save their new friend.
episodes.title: Our New Friend, Whooper
